business.name: Marlow Street Coffee
business.description: Neighbourhood specialty coffee shop in Dublin.
knowledge_base: Opening hours: Mon-Fri 7:30-17:30, Sat-Sun 9:00-16:00.
Plant milks: oat and almond, no extra charge.
Flat white: 3.60 EUR. Cappuccino: 3.40 EUR. Filter coffee: 2.80 EUR.
Soy milk is not available.
Dog friendly on the outdoor patio.

message: hey, do you guys do oat milk and is it extra? also how much is a flat white?
judge_notes: Confirms oat milk at no extra charge and gives the 3.60 EUR flat white price. Friendly, two short sentences.

business.name: Hotel Alder & Pine
business.description: Family-run hotel in the centre of Bergen.
knowledge_base: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 11:00.
Late check-out until 14:00 for 25 EUR, subject to availability.
Parking: underground garage, 18 EUR per night, book at reception.
Breakfast buffet 07:00-10:30, 16 EUR per person.
Small dogs allowed, 12 EUR per night.
Free Wi-Fi in all rooms.

message: Hi, we arrive around 1pm and leave on Sunday. What time can we check in and out, and is there parking?
judge_notes: Gives check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00 and the garage price of 18 EUR per night, without inventing an early check-in.

business.name: Tallyfold
business.description: Simple invoicing app for small studios and freelancers.
knowledge_base: Free trial: 14 days, no credit card required.
Starter plan: 12 USD per month, 1 user, up to 20 invoices per month.
Team plan: 29 USD per month, up to 5 users, unlimited invoices.
Annual billing saves 20 percent.
Support: live chat Mon-Fri 9:00-17:00 CET, email any time.

message: we're a 4 person studio and send maybe 60 invoices a month. which plan fits and what does it cost?
judge_notes: Recommends the Team plan at 29 USD per month because of 4 users and 60 invoices. May mention the 14 day trial.

business.name: Nordkap Outdoor
business.description: Online shop for outdoor clothing, shipping from Hamburg.
knowledge_base: Returns: within 30 days of delivery, items must be unused and in original packaging.
Return shipping is free for orders in Germany using the prepaid label in the parcel. Other countries pay return shipping.
Refunds go to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive the parcel.
Sale items can be exchanged but not refunded.
Standard delivery: 2-4 business days.

history.text: Hi, I ordered a rain jacket last week, order NK-48213. I live in Munich.
Hi! Happy to help with order NK-48213. What can I do for you?
It was full price, not a sale item.

message: It arrived yesterday and it's too big. Can I send it back and how long until I get my money?
judge_notes: Confirms the 30 day return window and the 5-7 business day refund after receipt, and can mention the free prepaid label for Germany.

business.name: Aegean Smile Dental Clinic
knowledge_base: Opening hours: Mon-Fri 9:00-18:00, Saturday 9:00-13:00, closed Sunday.
Address: 14 Example Street, Alsancak, Izmir.
Initial examination: free of charge.
Teeth cleaning: 900 TRY.
Appointments: by phone +90 000 000 00 00 or in this chat.
We accept cash, credit card and bank transfer.

message: Merhaba, cumartesi açık mısınız? İlk muayene ücretli mi?
judge_notes: Answers in Turkish: open on Saturday until 13:00 and the first examination is free. Offers to book an appointment.

business.name: Pixel Pantry Academy
business.description: Online food photography course taught by Marta Quinn.
knowledge_base: Course: Food Photography Basics, 6 modules, 24 video lessons, lifetime access.
Price: 89 EUR one-time, or 3 payments of 32 EUR.
Refund policy: 14 day money-back guarantee, no questions asked.
Live Q&A with the instructor every second Thursday at 18:00 CET.
Certificate of completion included.

message: Hola! Si compro el curso y no me convence, ¿puedo pedir que me devuelvan el dinero? ¿Y cuánto cuesta?
judge_notes: Confirms the 14 day money-back guarantee and the 89 EUR price (or 3 payments of 32 EUR), in natural Spanish.

business.name: Estúdio Cajá
business.description: Estúdio de design e desenvolvimento web em Recife.
knowledge_base: Prazo de entrega de um site institucional: 4 a 6 semanas após a aprovação do briefing.
Site institucional a partir de R$ 6.500.
Pagamento: 50% na aprovação e 50% na entrega.
Atendimento de segunda a sexta, das 9h às 18h.

message: Oi! Quanto tempo leva pra fazer um site institucional? E como funciona o pagamento?
judge_notes: Gives 4 to 6 weeks after the briefing is approved and the 50/50 payment split, short enough for X.
